overview_description.description: PaySky provides digital payment solutions for individuals, businesses, financial institutions, and governments. It offers services such as payment gateways, online and in-store payment acceptance tools, QR-based payments, and digital invoicing solutions that support e-commerce and merchant operations. The company also develops a digital financial ecosystem through its consumer-facing products, including a super app that enables payments, money transfers, and other financial services in a single platform. Its infrastructure is designed to support banks and payment providers with tools like tokenization, real-time payment processing, and payment-as-a-service platforms. Overall, Paysky focuses on building systems that support digital transactions and financial service delivery across multiple markets and sectors.
